name: What kind of warranty or guarantee should I expect from an exterior painting contractor?
description: Expect a workmanship warranty (1-5 years) from contractors covering application issues, plus the manufacturer's paint warranty. Clarify terms before starting.

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty or guarantee should I expect from an exterior painting contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reputable exterior painting contractors typically offer a warranty on their workmanship and the paint's performance. Workmanship warranties usually cover issues like peeling or blistering caused by improper application, often ranging from 1 to 5 years. Paint manufacturers also provide their own product warranties. It's crucial to clarify the specifics of any warranty, including what it covers, its duration, and the process for making a claim, before starting the project.
